# ORBii Interact

> Live Q&A, voting, polls, moderation and audience analytics for meetings, town halls, conferences, workshops, meetups and training sessions. Web application by ORBii SAS.

ORBii Interact (open-source name: Meetup Q&A) has two views: participants join with a link or a code and need no account; organisers run the session from a separate host view and can project questions on a shared screen.

## Features
- Before the event: create a space, share its link or code, prepare polls that stay hidden until launched.
- During the event: anonymous or named questions, upvotes, emoji reactions, moderation, pinning and highlighting, several poll formats including NPS and word cloud, agenda with sessions, big-screen view.
- After the event: the organiser keeps questions and analytics and can export them as CSV.
- Not available: scheduling of polls, discussion after an event is closed, automatic sending of an event report.
